text.tspan: AI
coach
Send one swing.
Hear what a coach
would tell you.
Film one swing from behind, upload it, and read

svg.text: For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap. A practice tool, not for competitive rounds.
Down the line, phone at hand height.
From your phone’s browser, at the range.
The fault, how sure it is, what to practise.
Dark bands show your swing. Light bands are the coach and you.

text.tspan: Film one swing,
down the line.
Phone behind you, along the target line. One
swing per clip, with your whole body and the
club in frame.

svg.text: 120 fps if your phone has it

text.tspan: Upload it before
your next ball.
Choose the clip in your phone’s browser. The
coach watches it in under a minute. Nothing is
kept unless you ask.

svg.text: Off. If on, the clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Pose → Swing events → Measurements → Rule table → Explanation

text.tspan: It measures
what moved.
Body lines on two key frames, address and
impact, measured against your own body
height.

svg.text: of body height, hips toward the ball
address → impact · the rule starts at 4%
Dashed: where your hips were at address.

text.tspan: Your hips are moving toward the ball through impact.
That’s early extension, and I’m sure of it.
It may feel like you stay down, but at
impact your hips have moved toward the ball.
Why does it feel like I’m staying
down when I’m not?
It happens below your eye line. The
impact frame
shows the gap to the dashed
address line. Keep your trail glute on
the wall in the
wall drill
to feel it.

svg.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.
Three faults, one fixed rule table.
If your swing shows something else, it says “No verified fault found”. It never forces one.
Hips move toward the ball, address → impact
Posture angle change, downswing vs address
Hand path in transition, above the backswing
Capped at medium confidence: hand path only, no club tracking.
When it can’t tell, it says so.
Three answers the coach gives instead of guessing.
I won’t guess from this clip.

text.tspan: None of my three rules fired on Nelly’s
swing, so I won’t prescribe a drill.
Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.

svg.text: Should I change my grip too?

text.tspan: I didn’t measure your grip in this
clip, so I can’t tell you. What I did
measure is your hips:
Answers are based only on this analysis —
no new faults, numbers or drills.

svg.text: Your coach is waiting for one swing.
Create an account, film a down-the-line clip, and read the answer at the range.
Your clips are private. Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool, not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
